summary: D08 reviewed its 55 nodes: 37 kept (three with text edits), 13 rewired, 1 rewired and rebalanced (horseshoe), 1 split and rewired (rocket), 2 rebalanced, 1 relocated; 5 new nodes. The split removes the tree's largest bottleneck: rocket (756,960 RP, every factor at its maximum) keeps its key as the liquid-fuel rocket (engine, missiles; 378,470) and the new orbital_launch_vehicle (R-7, 1957: spaceport, orbital launch, satellite gateway; 189,240) carries the rest. Causal and chronology fixes: sledge no longer needs post-and-beam framing (an inversion), carrack no longer descends from the caravel (Genoese carraca a century earlier), celestial_navigation no longer needs a ship type, cartography no longer needs paved roads, horseshoe no longer needs the horse collar, iron_hull no longer needs the screw, bicycle, electric_vehicle and jet_airliner gain the manufacturing or material knowledge they need, aircraft gains gliding flight, gps gains relativity and rocket gains Newtonian mechanics. Content rebalances: road_paved (material) and locomotive (material and institutional at loader maxima). New alternative routes: sail on reed-bundle boats (raft OR dugout) and an ocean-going junk route to the oceanic class; new missing knowledge: balloon, glider and the conventional submarine. polynesian_canoe moves to the trunk (voyaging without writing should not wait for the research stage). Live consumers are preserved: all road classes, the A3/A5/A7/A8 supporting facts and every entity id. Fog: no D08 node reveals territory; three reveal-reading strings (cartography, gps, earth_observation) are reworded; navigation grants only access eligibility (transport classes realized by the unscheduled transport packet where coast, timber and builders exist) or travel and sight parameters proposed for the transport packet and the fog lane.
